description: This file defines several custom attributes related to concurrency behaviors in Orleans grains, such as ReadOnly, Reentrant, Unordered, StatelessWorker, AlwaysInterleave, MayInterleave, and OneWay. These attributes are used to annotate grain classes or methods to influence runtime behavior and optimization strategies.

classes.name: ReadOnlyAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating that a method does not modify grain state, allowing runtime optimizations.

classes.name: ReentrantAttribute
classes.description: Attribute signaling that a grain class allows request interleaving for enhanced concurrency.

classes.name: UnorderedAttribute
classes.description: Attribute marking that message delivery order is not significant for the interface.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to mark a grain as a stateless worker with optional configuration for max local workers and idle worker removal behavior.

classes.name: AlwaysInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Attribute marking methods that can interleave with any other, including write requests.

classes.name: MayInterleaveAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating that request interleaving is controlled via a callback function.

classes.name: OneWayAttribute
classes.description: Attribute indicating that a method is one-way, with no response expected.
